records.determination: Interpretation and lexical meaning remain outside literal native construction; sf-Etabit assigns interpretation above D0.
Symbol and codepage definitions are D1 candidates; the 128-position Strmdocx profile is not D0 and not universal sf-Etabit canon.
records.next_decision: Assign exact record types and codepage/version qualifiers.

records.determination: Codepages must be explicit, scoped and non-inferable from raw bits.
records.next_decision: Define version and namespace syntax without assigning universal wire codes.

records.determination: Native references can inform D1/D2 recipes but current Python references and SHA-256 definition IDs are not sf-Etabit addresses.
records.next_decision: Define durable qualified reference form.

records.topic: glyph component root and word placement
records.determination: D1 permits atoms and molecules including word-like structures while D2 explicitly composes words; the exact boundary is unresolved.
records.next_decision: Place every Strmdocx native layer in D1, D2 or an external overlay with justification.

records.determination: Order is first-class and identity-bearing; membership-only bitmaps are insufficient.
records.next_decision: Define ordered occurrences and repeated-reference indexing.

records.determination: Sentences, paragraphs and documents are D2 composition candidates.
records.next_decision: Define reconstruction identity and occurrence semantics.

records.determination: Content hashes bind recipes but do not replace sf-UUID or occurrence identity.
records.next_decision: Separate content, occurrence, member and context identities.

records.determination: Replaceable interpretations can coexist with a locked baseline only as new qualified contexts or versions; the lock is not destructively edited.
records.next_decision: Define successor and deviation rules.

records.determination: Native assembly payloads contain layers and references forbidden on D0.
records.next_decision: Keep all native structure above D0.

records.determination: An archive or file is reconstructed structure, not automatically a D0 object; raw-value placement and locator semantics are undefined.
records.next_decision: Specify source-byte representation and external provenance without weakening D0.

records.determination: Lexical semantics and relations must remain distinct from meaning-free spelling constructions.
records.next_decision: Place semantic annotations and cross-map derivations.

records.determination: Provenance, hashes and derivation are external to D0.
records.next_decision: Choose D1, D2, attestation or later-overlay placement by record type.

records.determination: The Strmdocx service persistence default is not an sf-Etabit storage or Cypher implementation.
records.next_decision: Define whether an adapter may use SQLite only as noncanonical test storage.

records.determination: Immutable source, order, structure, theory, relation and composition maps match the conceptual multi-drive direction.
records.next_decision: Map conceptual map kinds to qualified storage roles.

records.determination: No live path, map API, transaction protocol, recovery contract or storage implementation exists.
records.next_decision: Specify a CPU-only reference substrate contract before any probe.

records.determination: Storage D0/D1/D2 and registry-preservation D0-D5 are different namespaces.
records.next_decision: Require fully qualified namespace names in every record and report.

records.determination: sf-UUID format, issuance, uniqueness, copy and replacement semantics are open; current hashes and stream UUIDs serve different roles.
records.next_decision: Approve an identity-role matrix before schema work.

records.determination: Membership is insufficient for order, repetition and exact reconstruction.
records.next_decision: Define sequence positions, duplicate occurrences, x/y widths and bounds.

records.determination: Current Strmdocx packages expose construction evidence through one process and do not prove a reader-denied metadata path.
records.next_decision: Define role capabilities and negative access tests.

records.determination: A single service owner cannot be called the internally distributed Cypher authority.
records.next_decision: Keep Cypher outside the first reference model or obtain explicit collective-decision rules.

records.determination: No accepted Strmdocx status or transaction semantics model refusal, revocation or alternative cooperation.
records.next_decision: Define refusal as a typed result before cross-project authority integration.

records.determination: The optional source set is not Strmdocx's alphabet and does not supersede safe ASCII.
Stored values must be typed separately from failure, unresolved reference and authorization status.
records.next_decision: Adopt a source-value/result type separation if the example is later used.

records.determination: Valid construction does not grant execution authority.
Control values remain literal data; the native model does not execute them.
Strmdocx requires semantic construction plus inspectable display; sf-Etabit v0.3 defines no renderer.
records.next_decision: Keep rendering as a consumer above reconstructed structures.

records.determination: Prior streams and alternate D2 stacks can remain addressable, but equivalence and deterministic selection are not defined across systems.
records.next_decision: Define equivalence evidence and selection rules.

records.determination: New streams and contexts preserve prior states rather than mutating them.
Current hashes and replay are bounded local evidence, not v0.3 high-friction persistent attestation.
records.next_decision: Define a reference-model validation profile without claiming full attestation.

records.determination: In-memory state and cached success cannot replace persistent validation.
The safe-ASCII profile is a bounded test decision that superseded CP437 only for its increment.
records.next_decision: Version future repertoires independently.

records.determination: Correct CPU semantics precede GPU work; no shared GPU representation exists.
Agentic control remains last and is not authorized by this study.
Source-faithful, decoded, constructed, inferred and enriched maps need explicit placement and derivation rules.
records.next_decision: Approve a map-family and provenance schema before bulk intake.

records.determination: No substantive governing Government-and-Binding source or adopted relation decoder exists.
records.next_decision: Designate and mine governing sources under a new gate.

records.determination: WordNet spellings do not authorize native root or affix declarations.
records.next_decision: Provide a governing construction source or direct curated declarations.

records.determination: Source files and archives are reconstructed objects; their byte identity can be preserved without treating them as D0 metadata-bearing objects.
records.next_decision: Define source locator and byte reconstruction records.

records.determination: A path is an external locator, not substrate identity or authority.
Strmdocx makes no full physical enumeration claim and must not inherit one by analogy.

proof_boundary: Crosswalk classifications are AUTH-20A analysis, not sf-Etabit canon, Strmdocx implementation approval, registry admission, or independent attestation.
